samples.title: Success, glass, confetti
samples.body: Welcome to Northwind, Maha. Your workspace has been created and a copy of your sign-in details is on its way to your inbox.

samples.title: Email sent, split, neutral wording
samples.body: If an account exists for m••••@northwind.sa, we sent a link to reset your password. The link works once and expires in 30 minutes.

samples.title: Success, minimal, redirect after countdown
samples.body: Your new password is active and other devices were signed out. Sign in with your new password

samples.title: Verified, brutal
samples.body: Thanks, maha.alharbi@northwind.sa is confirmed. You can now receive invoices and approval requests.

samples.title: Signed out, glass
samples.body: On a shared computer, close the browser as well. Sign in again

samples.title: Link expired, glass
samples.body: Reset links work once and for 30 minutes. Request a new one and use the most recent email.

samples.title: Error, split
samples.body: We couldn't finish creating your account and nothing was saved. Try again in a minute; if it keeps happening, contact support and quote reference 7F3K-2Q.

samples.title: Access denied, brutal
samples.body: Your account doesn't have permission to open Payroll. Ask your administrator for the Payroll Viewer role.
